questions.question: In his better days, why did people who heard Job call him blessed?

answers.text: He rescued the poor who cried out
He owned the finest house in town
He won every battle he fought

questions.question: Before his suffering, what did Job think his future would be?

answers.text: A long life ending in his own nest
A short life ending far from home
A quiet life ending in a stranger's house

questions.question: Job once expected his bow to stay renewed in his hand. What did Job say has happened to it now?
When Job cried out to God for help in his suffering, what did Job say God did?
